Class RainbowGumJBossLoggerProvider

java.lang.Object
io.jstach.rainbowgum.jbosslogging.RainbowGumJBossLoggerProvider
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.jboss.logging.LoggerProvider
@ServiceProvider(org.jboss.logging.LoggerProvider.class) public final class RainbowGumJBossLoggerProvider extends Object implements org.jboss.logging.LoggerProvider
Native LoggerProvider for JBoss Logging backed directly by LogRouter.global(), not through SLF4J.

MDC/NDC storage below is ported from upstream's own org.jboss.logging.AbstractLoggerProvider/AbstractMdcLoggerProvider (same behavior, including getNdc()'s space-joined merged form) since both are package-private and cannot be extended from outside org.jboss.logging. MDC values are stringified on put (mirroring Slf4jLoggerProvider's own MDC.put(key, String.valueOf(value))) so they can be surfaced directly as KeyValues without a second conversion step.
